title: GenAI & Agentic AI Security Incidents
description: A continuously-maintained, consolidated index of publicly disclosed GenAI and agentic-AI security incidents, vulnerabilities, and red-team findings. Every applicable entry is mapped to four core taxonomies (OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications (2026), OWASP Top 10 for Agentic Applications, NIST AI Risk Management Framework (AI 100-1), MITRE ATLAS). A companion MAESTRO architectural-layer mapping is carried where the source provides it, and an experimental VERIS 1.4.1 crosswalk is computed at export time. Exceptions: four mapping files (mappings/owasp_asi_top10.json, owasp_llm_top10_2026.json, owasp_llm_top10_2025.json, owasp_llm_2025_to_2026.json) are CC-BY-SA-4.0 AND CC-BY-4.0 (OWASP codes and names, and the OWASP LLM description text, are CC BY-SA 4.0); two entries (INC-02646, INC-03233) carry OWASP round-up text under CC BY-SA 4.0 pending rewrite; ingest/ snapshots keep their upstream terms; see NOTICE-DATA.
